label: VOX:iyuratd
en: A new comrade joins us.

label: VOX:iyurate
en: Look deeply into my eyes_

label: VOX:iyurmoa
en: Yes, of course.

label: VOX:iyurmob
en: Predictable.

label: VOX:iyurmoc
en: Thoughts received.

label: VOX:iyurmod
en: My command is your wish.

label: VOX:iyursea
en: Psychic ready.

label: VOX:iyurseb
en: Tell me your wish.

label: VOX:iyursec
en: I know your thoughts.

label: VOX:iyursed
en: Your mind is clear.

label: VOX:iyursee
en: The mind is quicker than the eye.

label: VOX:ma1ev01
en: Don't forget, Sir! Order Tanya as you see fit, but we CANNOT afford to lose her. You must reach Fort Bradley before it is destroyed.

label: VOX:ma1ev02
en: Looks like the bridge has been blown. We'll have to find another way to Fort Bradley.

label: VOX:ma1ev03
en: The Soviet Navy is attacking the Statue of Liberty! We can't let them get away with that! Sir, is there anything you can do?

label: VOX:ma1ev04
en: Doesn't sound good, Sir! We're going to have to double-time it the rest the way to reach Fort Bradley in time!

label: VOX:ma1ev05
en: Congratulations! We've reestablished contact with Fort Bradley! They're turning over control of the base and its troops to you.

label: VOX:ma1ev06
en: We seem to have lost power, sir! Build more power plants.

label: VOX:ma1ev07
en: Looks like the bridge has collapsed. We'll have to get our Engineers to repair it!

label: VOX:ma1ev08
en: Watch out for those Petroleum barrels - They seem highly unstable! Perhaps we can use them to our advantage...

label: VOX:ma1ev09
en: Our GI's are too exposed to enemy fire! Maybe they should take shelter in nearby buildings!

label: VOX:ma1ev10
en: Sir, I'm sorry to report that we've lost Tanya_

label: VOX:ma1ev11
en: There's the Supply Base! Destroy all of the buildings, and we'll buy some time for the rest of the country!

label: VOX:ma1ev12
en: We've done it Sir! The Supply Base has been eliminated!

label: VOX:ma1ev13
en: You must hurry to reach Fort Bradley as quickly as possible!

label: VOX:ma1ev14
en: To earn more credits, command your Chrono Miners to gather ore.

label: VOX:ma1ev15
en: This vehicle is known as a Chrono Miner - it can be used to gather valuable minerals, and when fully loaded will teleport back to the Refinery docking bay.

label: VOX:ma1ev16
en: Additional Soviet forces are incoming, and will surely arrive soon!

label: VOX:ma1ev17
en: Soviet paratroopers detected.

label: VOX:ma1ev18
en: Commander, you must reach Fort Bradley as quick... wait... What are those Dreadnoughts doing? They're attacking the Statue of Liberty? You can't let this happen!

label: VOX:ma1ev19
en: Liberty is fallen, sir. This looks like the beginning of the end.

label: VOX:ma1ev20
en: Tanya has perished, sir. We can't do this without her!

label: VOX:ma1ev21
en: Sir, Fort Bradley just reported that the Soviets have managed to establish a small supply base just southeast of here. If we can eliminate the supply base, perhaps can stall the invasion for a short while!

label: VOX:ma1ev22
en: Deploy an occupied civilian structure to evacuate its occupants.

label: VOX:ma2ta01
en: All right! This beacon's neutralized! Send in the cavalry

label: VOX:ma3ev01
en: You have discovered Allied units abandoned after the Soviet invasion.

label: VOX:ma3ev02
en: The Psychic Beacon must be destroyed, Commander!

label: VOX:ma3ev03
en: Watch out for Soviet troops garrisoned in civilian structures throughout the city!

label: VOX:ma4ev01
en: Objective 1: Use your paradrop squad to take out the Soviet Tesla Reactors, shutting down their harbor defenses.

label: VOX:ma4ev02
en: Objective 2:

label: VOX:ma4ev03
en: Seek out the Soviets' Tesla Reactors and take them out with your Destroyers, crippling their air defenses.

label: VOX:ma4ev04
en: Perhaps we should send our Destroyers scouting up the Chicago River, they may reveal key installations in the Soviet base.

label: VOX:ma5ev01
en: You can check one missile off your list, Sir! That bird will never fly again.

label: VOX:ma5ev02
en: Sir, we managed to capture one of the Silos - instead of destroying it! Why don't we just turn it against the other missile Silo?

label: VOX:ma5ev03
en: If you can get a Spy into one of those Tesla Generators, he can probably shut down all of the base's power for a good 30 seconds.

label: VOX:ma5ev04
en: I'm resizing your radar to compensate for the Nuclear missile coordinates that we just received. Stand by.

label: VOX:ma5ev05
en: Sir! You just blew up the Soviet Battlelab! Without the Missile Silo coordinates, we can't complete our mission!

label: VOX:ma5ev06
en: Congratulations, Sir! With both nukes neutralized, the European Alliance can join the war! We may have just changed the course of history!

label: VOX:ma5ev07
en: If you can get a Spy into one of those Tesla Generators, he can probably shut down all of the base's power for a good 60 seconds.

label: VOX:ma5ev08
en: Sir, Tanya is missing in action. Without her, our efforts here are in vain.

label: VOX:ma5i101
en: Thanks for rescuing us, Sir! Our plane was shot down by Soviet anti-aircraft. There's probably more survivors around here.

label: VOX:ma5i201
en: Glad you found us, Sir! We're freezing out here!

label: VOX:ma5i301
en: Good to see you, Sir! What are our orders?

label: VOX:ma5i401
en: Be on the lookout for spies, Comrade. It seems a little quiet tonight.

label: VOX:ma5i501
en: (Laugh) We don't need to worry about stupid American spies. That's what the dogs are for.

label: VOX:ma5ta01
en: Looks like we're going to need some more Spies, Sir!

label: VOX:ma5ta02
en: Sir, could you send some more Spies without neon camouflage this time?

label: VOX:ma5ta03
en: Looks like Spies are becoming an Endangered Species. Send some more!

label: VOX:ma5ta04
en: (Tanya swears several times and is 'beeped' out) Sorry, Sir, but we need some more Spies.

label: VOX:ma6ev01
en: Hey! That's not Lincoln. They've put a Stalin head on him!

label: VOX:ma6ev02
en: Sir, several of our vehicles have been eaten by Terror Drones. Our Service Depot can remove the drones and save our vehicles.

label: VOX:ma7ev01
en: Commander, Niihau Island has fallen. We should prepare the rest of Hawaii for invasion.

label: VOX:ma7ev02
en: Commander, the Soviets have finished construction of a nuclear missile launcher on Niihau. We must build Gap Generators to hide our base before they can launch.

label: VOX:ma8ia01
en: Can't concentrate voices in my head_ _victory to the Soviet Union.

label: VOX:ma8ia02
en: victory to the Sov we're free! Get'em!

label: VOX:ma8ta01
en: Must reach the beacon just a little bit farther long live the glorious peoples Soviet state.

label: VOX:ma9se01
en: We're going to need some help getting through those defenses.

label: VOX:ma9se02
en: Hot Tamale! That's no Mayan Pyramid_ that's a Prism Cannon.

label: VOX:ma9se03
en: Sir, these freedom fighters want to join up.

label: VOX:maaei01
en: What does this button do?

label: VOX:maaei02
en: Commander! Look out! They are over here.

label: VOX:maaei03
en: Get these commander! Here they are! Here!

label: VOX:maaei04
en: You should see this Commander!

label: VOX:maaev01
en: Please don't touch the auxiliary controls professor. They notify the commander of important events.

label: VOX:maaev02
en: Professor please stay off this channel.

label: VOX:maaev03
en: Professor Einstein! I'm sure the Commander sees that.

label: VOX:maaev04
en: Professor if you touch the controls again_

label: VOX:maaev05
en: Sir, if you build and deploy a spy satellite you will be able to see the entire combat area.

label: VOX:maaev06
en: We're rather low on resources in this location, sir. Perhaps you should construct an Ore Purifier so we can get more out of what we have.

label: VOX:mabev01
en: Commander, Marine World has loaned us their trained dolphins. They can be use a sonic enhancer to attack the Squids and drive them off our ships.

label: VOX:macev01
en: Attemping to jam Soviet Command's calls for help, but a few got through. Heavier Soviet reinforcements arriving soon.

label: VOX:macev02
en: Teleporting troops arriving in 5_ 4_ 3_ 2_ 1.

label: VOX:macev03
en: Intercepting broadcast from Soviet Command. Romanov's panicking, sir. He's called for air evacuation. The transports will arrive in 2 minutes.

label: VOX:macev04
en: Soviet evacuation transports arriving in 1 minute.

label: VOX:macev05
en: Soviet evacuation transports arriving in 30 seconds.

label: VOX:macev06
en: Sir, Romanov is calling for evacuation again. He is trying to escape.

label: VOX:macev07
en: Psionic Amplifier captured. Soviet units are defecting to our side.

label: VOX:macev08
en: Psionic Amplifier destroyed.

label: VOX:macev09
en: Romanov captured.

label: VOX:macev10
en: Teleporting troops arriving in 5_

label: VOX:macev11
en: Chrono Reinforcements have arrived.

label: VOX:macev12
en: Commander, the time to act is now. The bulk of our armies stand ready to be transported to this very location, but first Tanya must clear the way for them by eliminating the Psychic Amplifier.

label: VOX:macev13
en: Tanya has failed, sir. Our best efforts have been all for naught.

label: VOX:macev14
en: Sir, the Psychic Amplifier has been destroyed, and Soviet forces have begun to defect to our side!

label: VOX:macev15
en: Our objective now is simple: Tanya must capture Romanov from his hiding place - the Kremlin.

label: VOX:macev16
en: To capture Romanov, Tanya must enter the Kremlin.

label: VOX:macev17
en: The Soviet High Command has been alerted to our presence. Prepare for a Soviet counter attack.

label: VOX:macev18
en: With Romanov captured and being interrogated as we speak, it seems the Soviet menace has come to an end.

label: VOX:macis01
en: We will never surrender! Death to the Allies!

label: VOX:macta01
en: We can't let Romanov get away!

label: VOX:macve01
en: I'm going to be sick.

label: VOX:macve02
en: Where are we?

label: VOX:macve03
en: Is this Russia?

label: VOX:ms1so01
en: Commander, this is the first step in our glorious conquest. Victory here is crucial! Remember, we must crush the Pentagon - above all else, the Pentagon must be destroyed!

label: VOX:ms1so02
en: We can't let a mere bridge delay our conquest, commander! Order your Engineers to enter the bridge's control station!

label: VOX:ms1so03
en: Commander, pay no heed to casualties. For every Conscript who dies in the crusade, there are a thousand more who stand eager to replace him!

label: VOX:ms1so04
en: Commander, you can order your Conscripts into nearby buildings to fortify them against the enemy.

label: VOX:ms1so05
en: At last, the Pentagon is within our grasp! Destroy it, immediately.

label: VOX:ms1so06
en: Ah... Our Comrades have decided to lend us support. These reinforcement Commander, are some of our most useful vehicles _ Flak Tracks! Their speed armor, and ability to carry infantry are the perfect support for our legion of Conscripts

label: VOX:ms1so07
en: Superb, Commander! The Pentagon has been destroyed!

label: VOX:ms1so09
en: Our base is out of power! We must build more generators to bring our radar and defenses back online!

label: VOX:ms1so10
en: Be wary of those barrels of petrol! If damaged, they will surely explode violently. Perhaps we can use them to our advantage...

label: VOX:ms1so11
en: Capture the airport commander in order to allow paratroopers to land in the area.

label: VOX:ms1so12
en: Excellent, Comrade Commander! As soon as the Paratroopers are completely prepared, we will be able to strike anywhere you desire!

label: VOX:ms1so13
en: The building that you've just discovered is one of America's special civilian buildings. Use an Engineer to convert the building and gain its powers.

label: VOX:ms1so14
en: Deploy an occupied civilian structure to remove its occupants.

label: VOX:ms1so15
en: This useful vehicle is known as a War Miner - it can be used to gather valuable minerals, and will defend itself with a turret-mounted cannon.

label: VOX:ms1so16
en: To earn more credits, command your War Miners to gather ore.

label: VOX:ms1so17
en: Iron Curtained units detected.

label: VOX:ms1so18
en: Incoming Kirovs detected.

label: VOX:ms1so19
en: You must destroy the Kremlin, where Yuri is cowering.

label: VOX:ms3ca04
en: (droned) By your command, Comrade.

label: VOX:ms3ca05
en: (droned) Death to the capitalists!

label: VOX:ms3ca06
en: (droned) Glory to Mother Russia!

label: VOX:ms3ca07
en: I will obey the Soviet ooh! where am I?

label: VOX:ms3ia01
en: Yes master

label: VOX:ms3so01
en: Welcome to New York, Commander. Capture the Allied Battle Lab at the World Trade Center and use their technology to build the PSYCHIC BEACON

label: VOX:ms3so02
en: The beacon is placed, Commander, but it needs time to charge. Keep theAllies from destroying the beacon.

label: VOX:ms3so03
en: Beacon deployed and online.

label: VOX:ms3so04
en: Excellent, Commander. Now use our new _conscripts_ to deal with theremaining Allied forces.

label: VOX:ms3so05
en: Commander, capture these OIL DERRICKS for extra resources.

label: VOX:ms3so06
en: Conscripts are more effective when garrisoned inside civilian buildings, Commander.

label: VOX:ms4so01
en: Allied fleet has arrived.

label: VOX:ms4so02
en: I have displayed the estimated time remaining until the Allied fleet arrives, Commander.

label: VOX:ms4so03
en: The Allied air forces are threatening our position. Deploy our flak cannon and they will turn the enemy's air units into scrap metal.

label: VOX:ms5so01
en: Commander, there is an AIRPORT somewhere nearby. Capture it and you will be able to airdrop Conscripts.

label: VOX:ms5so02
en: Look for reinforcements stationed throughout the city, Commander.

label: VOX:ms5so03
en: Be careful, Commander, once you reach the Paris Tower the Allied forces are like to rush your position.

label: VOX:ms5te01
en: Get me close to the tower and I'll take care of the rest commander.

label: VOX:ms6so01
en: A small reinforcement fleet of new Soviet Dreadnoughts has arrived. Use them for long range shore bombardment.

label: VOX:aprotr1
en: Join the Allies! We have hot food, women, and guns for everyone.

label: VOX:aprotr2
en: Start a new life with the Allied Forces. You'll get all the bread and milk you could ever want.

label: VOX:aprotr3
en: Join the winning side. Be a pioneer of freedom with the New Soviet Democracy!

label: VOX:aprotr4
en: Free TVs for all who join us! Act now... freedom is yours for the taking.

label: VOX:aprotr5
en: Bring us the fat and lazy... come join in the decadent lifestyle of the west.

label: VOX:ms7so01
en: Sources have reported that Allied troops are amassing outside their Chronosphere. A squad has just been teleported.

label: VOX:ms7so02
en: Another enemy platoon has been teleported by the Chronosphere.

label: VOX:ms7so03
en: One last Allied platoon has been teleported by the Chronosphere.

label: VOX:ms8so01
en: Now that the beacon is destroyed, the Americans are free from Vladimir's mind control!

label: VOX:ms8so02
en: Destroy monuments to receive a cash bonus from Moscow.

label: VOX:ms9pr01
en: Get me outta here!

label: VOX:ms9pr02
en: You Soviet scum, you'll never take me!

label: VOX:ms9pr03
en: They're breaking in! Do something!

label: VOX:ms9pr04
en: You don't want the Vice President running the country, do you!?

label: VOX:ms9pr05
en: <death>

label: VOX:ms9se01
en: Get the President out of here! Go go go!

label: VOX:ms9so01
en: Intelligence reports that there is another bridge south of your position.

label: VOX:ms9so02
en: Yuri is in route to your position. Clear out the enemy defenses for his arrival.

label: VOX:ms9so03
en: Careful not to destroy the bunker, Commander. We want the President alive for interrogation.

label: VOX:ms9so04
en: The President is on the rescue ship. Sink the ship and we'll fish him from the water.

label: VOX:ms9yu01
en: Perhaps he needs some gentle persuasion.

label: VOX:msaso01
en: Greetings, Commander. Your forces need to invade the Allied base and take over their Battle Lab. Get an Engineer in there so we can pin-point the location of their Super Weapon.

label: VOX:msaso02
en: When your men are ready, I suggest you begin your assault here, Commander.

label: VOX:msaso03
en: This beach is well defended, but it is also the only place to land troops effectively. Good luck, Sir.

label: VOX:msaso04
en: Ah-ha, there it is! A Weather Control Device. Luckily Intel says that it couldn't possibly be operational yet. Take it out, Commander.

label: VOX:msaso05
en: Apparently our intelligence was wrong. Apologies, Commander. I'm now downloading schematics for a Nuclear Missile Silo so you can deal with this new threat.

label: VOX:msayu01
en: Perhaps I could be of assistance.

label: VOX:msbso01
en: Yuri will destroy us all. He must be stopped, no matter what the cost.

label: VOX:msbso02
en: (commenting on Yuri's invulnerable Iron Curtained soldiers) Commander, Yuri must be using an Iron Curtain device to make his troops invulnerable to attack! Intel indicates that the Iron Curtain effect can't possibly be maintained for long.

label: VOX:msbso05
en: Commander, looks like our Nuclear Silo has been noticed... Yuri's sending bunch of Kirovs our way!

label: VOX:msbso06
en: We'd better get some Flak Cannons in place.

label: VOX:msbyu01
en: You don't really think that War Factory will help you defeat me, do you?

label: VOX:msbyu02
en: So you're building a Kirov I'm impressed.

label: VOX:msbyu03
en: I wouldn't build that Psychic Sensor if I were you.

label: VOX:msbyu04
en: You're not really planning to nuke mother Russia, are you?

label: VOX:msbyu05
en: Terror Drones are such mindless beasts. Why don't you train an Engineer instead?

label: VOX:mscso03
en: Now move up the coast. There is a small airfield there where we can build a base and reclaim our captured Kirov airships.

label: VOX:mscso04
en: They are using the Chronosphere to transport troops into our base! We cannot stop this assault. Attack soon, Commander, or we will be overrun!

label: VOX:mt1ds01
en: Good morning commander and welcome to basic training. There's a war on so we have to make this a crash course. In front of you is your battlefield control interface. With this interface you can command any soldier on the field. Let's begin with the new recruit you see in the center of your screen. Move him away from his barracks and out into the field. Left click on the soldier to select him. Then left click on empty ground to move him to that location. Try not to get him killed on the way to the shooting range.

label: VOX:mt1ds02
en: Notice how you can order your soldier to move into the dark area surrounding the base. This shroud indicates areas of the terrain that you have not yet explored.

label: VOX:mt1ds03
en: Now that you've mastered the difficult task (said sarcastically) of commanding a single soldier, try ordering around a squad. First, select all of the men by left clicking and holding down the mouse button. In this mode you can drag a selection box around all of your men. Select all of the soldiers at once and order them north to the bridge.

label: VOX:mt1ds04
en: This bridge was destroyed yesterday when the Navy SEALs used it for demolition practice. An engineer is en-route to repair it. When he arrives, left click on him to select him then left click on the repair hut next to the bridge. Once the bridge is repaired, move your men across.

label: VOX:mt1ds05
en: This is the shooting range. Select your men by drag-selecting a box around the group. Once selected, left click on the targets down range. This will order your men to fire at these targets. Destroy all of the targets.

label: VOX:mt1ds06
en: Excellent, your men are good shots. There is a row of targets just out of range of your GIs. Double click on one of your men. He will set himself up in a small defensive position. In this mode he can fire at a greater range. Many units have special abilities like this. Now, order him to destroy the remaining targets.

label: VOX:mt1ds07
en: Notice that one of your men has a special symbol on him when he is selected. This unit is a veteran unit. Veterans are tougher, stronger and can fire more accurately than ordinary soldiers. Double click on the man who is set up in a defense position to order him to move-out. Now order your men to move on down the road.

label: VOX:mt1ds08
en: In front of you is a derelict American Grizzly Battle Tank. Order your men to destroy the crippled tank.

label: VOX:mt1ds09
en: It takes your men longer to destroy the tank than the targets at the rifle range. Regular soldiers are not efficient at destroying armored units. In turn, armored units may not be the most effective weapons for destroying dug in infantry. Pick the right unit when facing enemies. Good job today, you have completed an important part of your training.

label: VOX:mt1ds10
en: Hurry up commander, you're boring me.

label: VOX:mt1ds11
en: Keep it moving commander, your training has to go quickly, the Reds are already landing on our shores.

label: VOX:mt1ds12
en: Commander, this is only one soldier. In a few days you will have to command armies. Now left click on him and then left click on open ground to get him moving out of the base.

label: VOX:mt2ds01
en: Today you will fight a mock battle against another commander. He will command the red team, you will command of the blue team. Select your Mobil Construction Vehicle by left clicking on it and order it to move out of the base. Get it a safe distance away and try to find some open ground.

label: VOX:mt2ds02
en: Your Mobile Construction Vehicle is now in open ground. Double click on it to deploy a Construction Yard.

label: VOX:mt2ds03
en: Now that you have a Construction Yard you can begin to build a base. On the right hand side of your screen you can see that the icon for a Power Plant has appeared. Left click on that icon to start construction of the power plant. Notice how your remaining money decreases while the Power Plant is building. Each building has a cost to construct. When the Power Plant is done building, left click on it's image and then left click on an empty area near your Construction Yard. If you see red squares where you are trying to place the power plant then you are either trying to place the Power Plant too far away from your Construction Yard or you are trying to build on uneven ground.

label: VOX:mt2ds04
en: Good, your base now has power and you are ready to build more structures. Each buiding you construct also has a power cost. If you run short of power for all of your buildings, some will stop working, and others will work inefficiently. Left click on the Ore Refinery Icon on the right hand side of your screen to build a refinery.

label: VOX:mt2ds05
en: Now that you have placed a Power Plant you can build a barracks. Many buildings and units depend on one another. You cannot build a barracks until you have built a Power Plant. You cannot train soldiers until you have a barracks. Left click on the barracks to start its construction. When it is finished place it on the terrain just like you did with the Refinery and Power Plant.

label: VOX:mt2ds06
en: On the right hand side of your screen you should see a button that looks like a soldier. When you press that button you will see the different types of soldiers that you can train. Right now all you can train is a GI. Left click on the GI to start training him. Left click multiple times to train a series of GIs.

label: VOX:mt2ds07
en: Red team may attack soon. Your GIs are armed with rubber bullets for this mission. In real combat they would of course be shooting real bullets.

label: VOX:mt2ds08
en: Here comes red team, make me proud commander.

label: VOX:mt2ds09
en: Red team's strike force has been defeated. Now build some more soldiers commander and when you feel you are ready, move them out onto the map. Find Red team's Command Center and destroy it.

label: VOX:mt2ds10
en: You really weren't ready for red team were you commander? If this had happened against the Soviets, your base would now be in flames. Red team will pull back to give you a chance to build some more troops.

label: VOX:mt2ds11
en: Good job commander, you have defeated the red team. Your basic training complete.

label: VOX:mt2ds12
en: Your new Chrono Miner will automatically begin to collect ore.

label: VOX:mt2ds13
en: WARNING: The Red Team invasion imminent.

label: VOX:mt2ds14
en: Deploy your GIs near the entrance to your base for a better defense.

label: VOX:mt2ds15
en: Send your troops to garrison inside the barn for better protection from enemy fire.

label: VOX:mt2ds16
en: Send your troops to garrison inside civilian structures for better protection from enemy fire.

label: VOX:mt2ds17
en: Now is not the time for potty breaks, Commander.

label: VOX:mt2ds18
en: No time to sit, Commander.

label: VOX:mt2ds19
en: WARNING: The stench of Red Team is in the air.

label: VOX:mt2ds20
en: Now that you'e mastered the difficult task (said sarcastically) of commanding a single soldier, try ordering around a squad. First, select all of the men by left clicking and holding down the mouse button. In this mode you can drag a selection box around all of your men. Select all of the soldiers at once and order them East to the bridge.

label: VOX:mt2ds21
en: Notice that one of your men has a special symbol on him when he is selected. This unit is a veteran unit. Veterans are tougher, stronger and can fire more accurately than ordinary soldiers. Double click on the man who is set up in a defense position to order him to move-out. Now order your men to move on up the road.

label: VOX:tauam01
en: Gosh darn it, I need more cash!

label: VOX:tauam02
en: Yippy-kai-aye, I'm going in!

label: VOX:tauam03
en: Anytime you want to get into the fight, just jump on in.

label: VOX:tauam04
en: Try to distract him, I've got a plan.

label: VOX:tauam05
en: If you give up now, I promise amnesty for you and your men.

label: VOX:tauam06
en: Hahahaha.

label: VOX:tauam07
en: That was a cowards tactic.

label: VOX:tauam08
en: It's too late to surrender now.

label: VOX:taubr01
en: I am running a little low of cash.

label: VOX:taubr02
en: Attention, I am about to attack.

label: VOX:taubr03
en: Your help would be greatly appreciated.

label: VOX:taubr04
en: Try to get the enemies attention, me and the lads are going to try something.

label: VOX:taubr05
en: Perhaps you should surrender, and avoid further bloodshed.

label: VOX:taubr07
en: That was hardly fair, now was it?

label: VOX:taubr08
en: Heads up old boy, here I come.

label: VOX:taucu01
en: How can I fight without money?

label: VOX:taucu02
en: I attack, now!

label: VOX:taucu03
